purpose: have an independent person judge whether a change is correct, safe and maintainable before it merges
entry_criteria: Change is small enough to review (split otherwise) and linked to a work item
CI checks for the change have finished
inputs: linked work item and acceptance criteria
procedure: Read the description and acceptance criteria first, then the diff; confirm the change matches the stated intent.
Check behavior: edge cases, error paths, concurrency, data handling and backward compatibility.
Check tests: do they fail without the change, and do they assert behavior rather than implementation details.
Check security and privacy: input validation, authorization, secrets, logging of sensitive data.
Write findings with file and line, impact and a suggested fix; label each blocker or suggestion.
Re-review the author's fixes and approve only when all blockers are resolved.
deliverables: list of deferred items with issue links
acceptance_criteria: All blocker comments are resolved or explicitly deferred with an issue
Reviewer ran or read the tests that cover the change
Approval is on the final commit, not an earlier one
Reviewer is independent of the author
validation_method: Approval recorded against the exact head commit.

validation.expect: diff size matches what the reviewer was asked to review
reviewDecision is APPROVED and headRefOid equals the commit reviewed

failure_modes.detection: Approval with no comments on a large risky diff
failure_modes.response: Request a second reviewer for risky areas

failure_modes.detection: headRefOid differs from the approved commit

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A change adds a discount code. Review finds the discount can be applied twice by retrying the request (blocker) and a missing test for negative totals (suggestion). The author adds an idempotency check and test; the reviewer approves the new commit.
